Elaine (Partnerships): Heads-up: ZenCloud marketplace reported 502 spikes on our hosted model endpoints starting ~08:05 PDT. They've asked for a joint war room — can we confirm routing + alerting responsibilities?
Sam (Support): On it. Are they in the shared channel? @Taylor are you online?
Taylor (ZenCloud liaison): Yep I'm here. They created a private shared channel: #zencloud-redwood-prod. ZenCloud wants us to run 1st-line SEV triage.
Raj (Eng-Oncall): If it's 502s, likely backend autoscaler flapping or proxy. @Marta can you pull recent 10m error rates? I can standby for bridge.
Marta (Eng-SRE): Checking now. 08:02-08:10 spikes: host-proxy 502s up ~18% and instance OOMs on dedicated pool a1. Pulling logs and heap dumps.
infra-bot: Alert: service/model-endpoint-x - 502 rate 18% - pv spikes - runbook suggested: 'start-warroom'
Alex (Sales): :thumbsup: We should make the playbook explicit. Proposal: use shared channel for initial comms, create war room (Zoom + pinned runbook + pager notes), and follow a contact ladder. Who is 2nd-level for ZenCloud? @Elaine
Elaine (Partnerships): ZenCloud expects us to own infra until we confirm it's on their side. We'll triage for 30 mins then hand to their platform team. They want phone-level wakeup for Sev2+ after 15m.
Sam (Support): Suggested contact ladder for prod SEV: 1) oncall -> 2) eng-sre -> 3) eng-oncall -> 4) partnerships lead -> 5) on-call exec. Pin this in shared channel.
Raj (Eng-Oncall): Agreed. Add concrete steps in the channel: 1) Acknowledge in shared channel within 5m 2) Start war room + paste link 3) Post initial hypothesis + key metrics 4) If unresolved in 15m, escalate to phone + pager.
Taylor (ZenCloud liaison): ZenCloud ops contact: +1-555-842-901 (ops), Pager: zen-ops@pagerduty.com. They prefer a call before escalating pager for joint launches.
Marta (Eng-SRE): Quick update: seeing repeated OOMs on instance-4; candidates: regression in recent model or memory leak. Recommend rollback to last-known-good model v1-20260310. If approved I'll trigger rollback and monitor.
Raj (Eng-Oncall): Approve rollback. Also enable mitigation: route traffic to read-only replica and enable KV cache warmup while rollback proceeds.
Sam (Support): Rollback initiated. Command used: ```redeploy --model model-x --version v1-20260310 --route=canary=0.8```
infra-bot: Deployment event: rollback to v1-20260310 initiated by Sam at 08:14 PDT - status: in progress
Taylor (ZenCloud liaison): ZenCloud confirms error rate dropped to ~1.2% after the rollback. They appreciated the quick ownership. They've requested a formal SEV playbook doc and a 1hr postmortem tomorrow.
Elaine (Partnerships): Good work. Action items: (a) draft SEV playbook + contact ladder (Sam) (b) add pinned phone numbers + escalation SLAs (Alex) (c) automate warroom creation via bot (Marta) (d) schedule postmortem & compile logs (me). I'll follow up with ZenCloud on handoff expectations.
Alex (Sales): :ok_hand: I'll draft the partner-facing playbook template and post to #partnerships-playbooks by EOD.
Taylor (ZenCloud liaison): Thanks everyone — ZenCloud will join the postmortem. Closing the war room in 30m unless new issues surface.
